title: Israel formally declares a state of war against Hamas
body:
On Sunday 8 October 2023, the day after the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel, the Israeli cabinet approved a formal declaration of a state of war. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had said earlier that Israel was at war, stating: "Not an 'operation,' not a 'round,' but at war." He added that the enemy would pay an unprecedented price. Netanyahu's first public statement that Israel was at war came on 7 October, but the legal declaration followed a day later.

Al Jazeera reported that the cabinet approval allowed the prime minister and the defence minister to make military decisions without consulting the full cabinet on each action. The Israel Defense Forces named its campaign Operation Swords of Iron. Netanyahu ordered the mobilisation of more than 100,000 reservists, who gathered near the Gaza border fence ahead of a possible ground invasion.

At the time of the report, Al Jazeera cited figures of more than 700 Israelis killed, including dozens of soldiers, and more than 400 Palestinians killed in Israeli air strikes, without naming a specific source for either figure. It also reported that more than 120,000 Palestinians had been displaced by the bombardment.
